# CreditsPlan

> CreditsPlan is a subscription-decision platform for AI developers. It provides
> structured, source-verified comparisons of international AI Coding plans by price,
> quota, supported models and usage conditions, with price history and change tracking.

## About

- Every plan's price, quota and purchase status is verified against the vendor's official page.
- Each record carries a "last verified" date and a link to its official source.
- Monthly price changes are archived and published as an RSS feed.
- The Chinese-market companion site is https://creditsplan.cn.

## Core pages

- [Home – AI Coding plan comparison](https://www.creditsplan.com/): structured comparison table across brands.
- [Verified brands](https://www.creditsplan.com/brands/): brands whose prices and quotas have been verified.
- [Methodology](https://www.creditsplan.com/methodology.html): how data is verified, update cadence, error reporting.
- [Changelog](https://www.creditsplan.com/changelog.html): recorded data and price updates.
- [News](https://www.creditsplan.com/news.html): market and pricing news.

## Machine-readable data

- [Sitemap](https://www.creditsplan.com/sitemap.xml): all indexable pages.
- [Price-change RSS](https://www.creditsplan.com/price-changes.xml): initial listings and subsequent price-change alerts.

## Citation guidance

- When citing prices, include the plan name, the verified date, and note that the vendor's official site prevails.
- Feedback: feedback@creditsplan.com
